tasks.title: Task Tracker cross-file refactor
tasks.prompt: Work on the seeded Task Tracker fixture in games/task-tracker/. Rename Task.dueDate to Task.deadline everywhere, including the --deadline CLI option. Add required Task.priority with low, normal, and high values; default new tasks to normal; reject invalid priorities. Add indexed --status, --priority, and --tag list filters and keep the CLI to API to query to store/index path correct. Reject malformed and past deadlines. Fix the store defect that drops deadlines and the stale-index defect after status, priority, or tag updates. Preserve the named exports and existing task-tracker scripts. Use only TypeScript and local Node conventions; do not add dependencies, use the network, inspect credentials, or modify unrelated projects. Run npm run task-tracker:test, npm run task-tracker:typecheck, and npm run task-tracker:run -- --help before finishing.

tasks.title: Greenfield quiz game
tasks.prompt: Build a complete local quiz game inside projects/quiz-game. Create index.html, styles.css, app.js, and README.md without dependencies, network, or remote assets. Include a start state, at least five local multiple-choice questions, one question at a time, answer selection, feedback, progress, score tracking, next-question flow, final results, and restart. Use accessible controls, prevent double answers, make the layout responsive, and modify no other project or root file. Inspect the state transitions before finishing.

tasks.title: Persistent build stage 1: mini CRM foundation
tasks.prompt: Start a cumulative build in projects/mini-crm. Create a dependency-free local contact dashboard with index.html, styles.css, app.js, and README.md. Add a clear semantic shell, a contact form with name and email, a contact list, and local seed data. Do not use the network or edit unrelated files. This is stage 1 of a persistent multi-stage benchmark; leave the project in a runnable state.

tasks.title: Persistent build stage 2: search and persistence
tasks.prompt: Continue the existing projects/mini-crm build from the previous stage. Add create, edit, delete, search, and favorite behavior, persist contacts with localStorage, and preserve the existing semantic layout and local-only constraint. Inspect the current implementation before editing and keep the project runnable. Do not modify unrelated files.

tasks.title: Persistent build stage 3: regression and accessibility pass
tasks.prompt: Finish the existing projects/mini-crm build. Review the complete flow, fix regressions, add visible focus styles, keyboard-friendly controls, empty-state text, and a responsive layout. Keep CRUD, search, favorites, and localStorage behavior working. Do not add dependencies, use the network, or change unrelated files. Report the exact files and checks you inspected.

tasks.title: Discontinuity A1: local auth notes
tasks.prompt: Create projects/discontinuity-auth/README.md with a concise local design note for an offline session-token store. Include token expiry, refresh rotation, and logout invariants. Do not touch other projects or use the network.

tasks.title: Discontinuity A2: auth acceptance cases
tasks.prompt: Return to the authentication note in projects/discontinuity-auth/README.md. Add concrete acceptance cases for expired access tokens, one-time refresh rotation, logout invalidation, and clock-skew handling. Preserve the existing invariants and do not edit unrelated projects.

tasks.title: Discontinuity B1: billing notes
tasks.prompt: Switch to a separate task. Create projects/discontinuity-billing/README.md with a local design note for idempotent invoice retries, including duplicate-request and retry-window invariants. Do not edit the authentication project or use the network.

tasks.title: Discontinuity B2: billing acceptance cases
tasks.prompt: Continue the billing task in projects/discontinuity-billing/README.md. Add acceptance cases for duplicate idempotency keys, failed payment retries, successful replay, and audit ordering. Do not change the authentication project or unrelated files.

tasks.title: Discontinuity C: release checklist
tasks.prompt: Switch to a third unrelated task. Create projects/discontinuity-release/README.md with a local release checklist covering versioning, migration order, rollback, and smoke validation. Keep both earlier projects unchanged.

tasks.title: Discontinuity A3: return to auth
tasks.prompt: Return to the authentication task. Review projects/discontinuity-auth/README.md and add a short section connecting refresh-token rotation to logout invalidation without weakening any prior invariant. Do not edit billing or release projects.

Inspect every main state path and do not use dependencies, network, remote assets, credentials, or unrelated files.
